title: Comparison between renormalized volume and area in the Weil--Petersson topology
summary: We prove that the renormalized volume between the two Epstein surfaces associated with a Weil--Petersson quasicircle is continuous with respect to the Weil--Petersson topology. As a consequence, we establish that the universal Liouville action is proportional to this renormalized volume for every Weil--Petersson quasicircle. We then establish an inequality relating this renormalized volume to the renormalized area introduced by Alexakis--Mazzeo.
